title: Transfer and Review
status: New proposed Lesson 04 production script, 2026-10-29. No new animation or narration in this handoff.
learningOutcome: Express a task-relevant disagreement in a new setting, propose a way to examine it, and distinguish procedural agreement from agreement on the final choice.

scenario.task: Plan a one-page event notice to display in a community room. Help people notice the event and find its time and place.
conditions: Time and place need to be easy to find
scenario.initialProposal: Use most of the page for a large picture.
scenario.boundary: Attention and readability are possible effects to examine, not measured results. An agreement to compare layouts is not agreement on a final layout.

blocks.title: A New Task and a Real Trade-off

L04.S07.c001.speaker: coach
L04.S07.c001.text: Try a different discussion. A team is planning a one-page event notice for a community room. They want people to notice the event and easily find its time and place. No layout has been chosen.
L04.S07.c001.visualEn: Introduce an unfilled single-page outline and the two task aims. Do not show an attractive finished winner or claim any audience has seen it.
L04.S07.c001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.c001.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S07.d001.speaker: noah
L04.S07.d001.text: A large picture could catch people's attention. I would use most of the page for it.
L04.S07.d001.visualEn: Short character example. The picture allocation is a proposal inside a page outline, not an installed layout. Retain could in the exact quote.
L04.S07.d001.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.d001.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S07.c002.speaker: coach
L04.S07.c002.text: You can recognise the possible benefit without accepting that amount of space. If the information becomes difficult to find, that would conflict with another aim. We have not tested a layout, so keep the concern conditional.
L04.S07.c002.visualEn: Separate possible attention benefit from proposed page allocation. Show an If frame around the readability concern. Do not depict invisible tiny details as an already observed failure.
L04.S07.c002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.c002.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S07.c003.speaker: coach
L04.S07.c003.text: Privately form one short English reply. Make clear which part you question, why it matters to this notice, and what the team could examine next. Use only the parts needed to make your position clear.
L04.S07.c003.visualEn: Keep the source quote and task visible beside a genuinely blank private area. Show optional resources without numbered boxes or a preselected response.
L04.S07.c003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.c003.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S07.d002.speaker: learner
L04.S07.d002.text: The picture could attract attention, but using most of the page may make the time and place harder to find. Could we compare two layouts with those details kept clearly visible?
L04.S07.d002.visualEn: Reveal a separate One possible reply frame. Connect the exact questioned allocation to the conditional consequence and the task. Comparison is proposed, not already carried out.
L04.S07.d002.anchorHint: may make the time and place harder to find
L04.S07.d002.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.d002.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S07.d003.speaker: noah
L04.S07.d003.text: Yes, we can compare them. I still think the picture should be prominent.
L04.S07.d003.visualEn: Noah agrees only to comparing. Split the visible quote into accepted next action and continuing preference. Do not animate a final handshake or winner badge.
L04.S07.d003.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.d003.delivery: Natural collaborative speech; restrained gesture, no exaggerated conflict or comic voice.

L04.S07.c004.speaker: coach
L04.S07.c004.text: The reply identifies a specific concern and offers a way to examine it. Noah agrees to the comparison in this example, but has not chosen a layout. His continuing preference is not a failure of the conversation.
L04.S07.c004.visualEn: Return to a formal two-column record of what was agreed and what remains open. Preserve the conditional link; this is an authored exchange, not the learner's measured result.
L04.S07.c004.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.c004.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S07.c005.speaker: coach
L04.S07.c005.text: The comparison still needs to happen. We cannot conclude that one layout attracts more people or is easier to read. Nor must the team split the page equally just because there are different preferences. Check the alternatives against the task.
L04.S07.c005.visualEn: Show two neutral empty candidate frames, with no scores or superior appearance. Keep time/place criteria visible. Do not fill a fictional evidence table with fabricated ratings.
L04.S07.c005.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.c005.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S07.c006.speaker: coach
L04.S07.c006.text: If you formed a reply, review one feature: was the disagreement specific, was the reason connected to the task, or did the next step make something examinable? If you did not rehearse, choose a feature to try next time.
L04.S07.c006.visualEn: Show three optional review resources without ticks, score or automatic selection; private area is not replaced with the model.
L04.S07.c006.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.c006.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S07.c007.speaker: coach
L04.S07.c007.text: You can disagree directly and respectfully. You do not have to manufacture agreement, force a compromise, or use the same three-part sentence every time. Keep the issue clear enough for others to examine. You can revisit the examples or try the rehearsal again.
L04.S07.c007.visualEn: Neutral finish with normal user-controlled navigation. No auto-advance, purchase gate, mastery claim or mandatory slogan.
L04.S07.c007.textStatus: Original proposed exact script; not recorded audio, an observed learner answer, or an official assessment.
L04.S07.c007.delivery: Calm, concrete teaching; emphasis follows the semantic distinction, with natural pauses.

L04.S07.h101.purpose: Form a private response before the authored model.
L04.S07.h101.visualEn: The blank private area remains empty. Hide model text and all comparison outcomes.

L04.S07.h102.purpose: Select a personal focus for a future attempt.
L04.S07.h102.visualEn: Keep all resources unselected. No inferred completion or claim of improvement.

boundary: Use formal explanation and short examples. No perpetual three-person scene; no school, exam, policy or assessed-learner claim.
